skill.name: Where the sentence ends: full stops and capitals
skill.why: A full stop tells readers to stop. Miss it and ideas crash together.
skill.how: End each whole thought with a full stop. Start the next one with a capital.

beats.say: A sentence is one whole thought. A full stop ends it.
The next sentence starts with a capital letter.
beats.show: The yeti sneezed**.** **T**he igloo fell down.

beats.say: Put the stop in the wrong spot and things get weird.
beats.show: Mo was cooking his sister**.** Was starving.

beats.say: Stop after the whole thought. Phew, she's safe.
beats.show: Mo was cooking**.** **H**is sister was starving.

beats.say: Names and the word I always get capitals too.
